title: Community
heading: An inquiry worth sharing.
description: Lived experience, open questions, and thoughtful conversation around the writing of Henok Ghebrechristos.
invitation: Start with a passage that speaks to you. Bring a question, a different experience, or a disagreement. Agreement with Digital Organism Theory is not a condition of conversation.
status: The community begins with direct conversations with Henok. There is no shared discussion space open here yet. Membership is by invitation; a request does not create an account or guarantee admission.
conversationTitle: What did the writing bring up for you?
conversationDescription: Share what resonated, what did not, or what your own experience adds. Your message goes privately to Henok; it is not posted publicly or added to a mailing list.
principlesTitle: Room for difference. Care for each other.

principles.title: Speak from experience
principles.description: Distinguish what happened, how you interpret it, and what remains uncertain.

principles.title: Question with care
principles.description: Challenge an idea without making the person defending it an enemy.

principles.title: Respect another person’s story
principles.description: Ask permission before sharing someone else’s words or personal details.

principles.title: Come and go freely
principles.description: Read at your own pace. Participation, subscription, and financial support are separate choices.

followTitle: Keep in touch, at your pace.
followDescription: The reader list offers occasional writing updates after you confirm your address. RSS is available without signup. Neither gives you membership, and the list is easy to leave.
supportTitle: Help sustain the work, if you wish.
supportDescription: Optional, one-time contributions support independent writing and research. Choose your own amount. Reading the complete book and downloading its PDF remain free.
supportNote: Contributing buys no membership, access, or influence. Available payment methods are shown on the support page.
